steps.npc: We seed the hidden truths of this world! Ranul rewards all of us who are willing to find them!
Ralos and Ranul are the twin guardians of our fate! Trust in them, for they will lead us to our destinies!
Do not fear the dark of night! Embrace it, for it is a gift from Ranul!
In times of sorrow, we look to Ralos and Ranul. They guide us through day and night.
Be bold in the day, but reflect in the night! Let the teachings of both Ralos and Ranul guide you equally!
Ralos teaches us to be brave! To be bold! Let his warmth in, and it will burn away all doubts!
Ralos shines upon us who are brave! If we show the courage to act, he will reward us!
